craft_notes: Sthāyin: mudrā-vidhi unit 39. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 7. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: There by union of those conditions grants opening; who knows, he would succeed indeed of reception and emission of sap.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra tatpadasaṃyogādunmīlanavidhāyinī yo jānāti sa siddhyettu rasādānavisargayoḥ
